title: Multi-app waitlist intake for Babulus (disabled until approved)
description:
As Ryan, I want Prospectus to accept waitlist signups for other Anthus apps, starting with Babulus, so apps stop running their own waitlist backends.

Feature: Multi-app waitlist intake
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given a config-driven registry of intake forms with origins bound to their own form
    When a Babulus waitlist signup arrives from an allowed Babulus origin
    Then it lands as a lead on the existing prospect for that email without creating accounts, memberships, entitlements or appointments
    And the Babulus entry ships disabled until Ryan approves owner, privacy notice, retention, abuse controls and real-cloud acceptance

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-20 drift fix: merged in PR #48 (06189f8, 2026-10-20 00:34Z). The Babulus entry ships disabled until Ryan approves owner, privacy notice, retention, abuse controls and real-cloud acceptance; none of those approvals is recorded on the board, so the entry stays disabled. Status left in_progress for that gate.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan approved 2026-10-20 (in chat): owner intake-queue; notice babulus-waitlist-v1 = Babulus /privacy text with marketing opt-in unticked by default and the line 'We keep your signup until you ask us to delete it. To unsubscribe or request deletion, email the Anthus info role mailbox named there.'; retention until the person asks for deletion; abuse controls as built (route throttle rate 1 / burst 2, per-form origin binding, honeypot, strict attributes, always-accept store-then-file); only origin to start is https://babulus.anth.us; real-cloud acceptance is a labelled test signup after enablement. Enabling PR: claude/enable-babulus-waitlist. Issue stays open until the live test passes.
